note: Whole DELIVERIES (a shots.json and an adapter.json sent together) and whether each is REFUSED before anything is written. Run by BOTH sides: the kit sends each through SyncNova.Run into an empty project (refused = a refusal, and no file on disk), and the website through runShotsSendCheck (refused = not sent). Added 2026-09-22 (the ninth audit of slice A2'). 'shots' is the document; absent, it is one shot 'a' with a one-second wait. 'adapter' is adapter.json WITHOUT its gameId, which each runner fills in with its own game; absent, it is only that gameId. A case with 'setupCount' N has one shot 'a' whose setup is 'raw lever0' ... 'raw lever<N-1>'. 'maxLevers' is the number both sides refuse above (the kit's Levers.MaxLevers, the site's MAX_LEVERS); each suite asserts its constant is this one. Added 2026-09-22 (the tenth audit): 'shotsText' is a shots.json given VERBATIM instead of 'shots' (a text that is not a JSON object), and 'bom' lists the files ('shots', 'adapter') whose text each runner sends with a leading U+FEFF. Added 2026-09-22 (the eleventh audit): 'maxLeverLength' is the longest lever both sides take (the kit's Levers.MaxLeverLength, the site's MAX_LEVER_LENGTH), in characters of the lever's own text, prefix and all; 'maxNesting' is the deepest nesting of arrays and objects both sides read (the kit's NovaJson.MaxNesting, the site's MAX_JSON_NESTING), counting containers only; 'schemaVersionDepth' N makes shots.json the TEXT {"$schemaVersion": 1 inside N arrays, "shots": []}, built by each runner rather than stored, because the fixture itself is read by the kit's own capped reader; 'noteDepth' {file: N} puts a top-level "note" of N nested empty arrays at the front of that file's text. Every delivery the kit WRITES must then load with no error at all: the delivery check is the loader. Added 2026-09-22 (the twelfth audit): 'minSeconds' is the smallest number of seconds both sides take in any field they read as seconds (the kit's JsonShotLoader.MinSeconds, the site's MIN_SECONDS; a number below it, or one that is not finite, is refused), and 'maxShotName' is the longest shot name both take, in characters (the kit's JsonShotLoader.MaxShotName, the site's MAX_SHOT_NAME). The file is DATA: a case one side disagrees with is a finding to take to both sides, never a line to edit here. Added 2026-09-22 (the thirteenth audit): 'maxSetup' is the most setup commands one shot may list and 'maxSteps' the most steps (the kit's JsonShotLoader.MaxSetup and MaxSteps, the site's MAX_SETUP and MAX_STEPS); 'maxConditionParts' the most parts one condition may hold, counting the parts of every 'all' inside it (JsonShotLoader.MaxConditionParts, MAX_CONDITION_PARTS); and 'maxSeconds' the most seconds any field read as seconds may hold (JsonShotLoader.MaxSeconds, MAX_SECONDS). A case with 'setupRepeat' {command, count} has one shot 'a' whose setup is that command, count times, with one one-second wait; 'stepsCount' N has one shot 'a' of N one-second waits; 'allParts' N has one shot 'a' with one one-second wait whose settle is an 'all' of N parts {"kind": "absent", "name": "N<i>"}. Each runner builds these; they are not stored.

cases.name: exactly maxLevers levers
cases.why: at the cap: taken

cases.name: one lever over maxLevers
cases.why: over the cap (the ninth audit, S1): the consent window's cost grows with the levers a delivery asks for, and a server decides how many that is

cases.name: maxLevers in shots.json and one more in adapter.json
cases.why: the two files' levers are counted together, as the window lists them

cases.name: the ninth audit's M1: a shot with no parameters holds SelectHero {knight}, beside a shot that declares k
cases.why: shot a is never bound, so its text reached the gate as SelectHero {knight}, which a tick of SelectHero {k} covered by shape

cases.name: control: the shot that declares its placeholder, alone
cases.why: every placeholder in its levers is one of its own parameters

cases.name: a placeholder only ANOTHER shot declares
cases.why: a shot's placeholders are bound from that shot's parameters only

cases.name: a cheat step's placeholder, undeclared
cases.why: a cheat command is a lever like a setup entry

cases.name: control: a click name's placeholder is not a lever
cases.why: a click name is looked up among the game's objects, never matched against a tick

cases.name: a ready write holds a placeholder
cases.why: nothing binds a placeholder in adapter.json: the editor sends a ready write as written

cases.name: the fourteenth audit: muteGet is a lever, so a placeholder in it is refused
cases.why: muteGet is sent as 'get Audio.{v}', a lever like any other since the fourteenth audit (it runs a property getter, which is code), and nothing binds a placeholder in adapter.json. Until then this was the control 'muteGet is a read, not a lever'

cases.name: an overlay type named {t}
cases.why: a type name holds no placeholder, and hide-overlay {t} is never bound

cases.name: the ninth audit's M4: a line break in a lever
cases.why: the window draws one line, and the bridge splits the command at the break, so 9999 runs as another argument

cases.name: U+2028 in a lever
cases.why: a line separator: the same as a line break

cases.name: U+0085 in a ready write
cases.why: a next-line control character, in adapter.json's half of the delivery

cases.name: the tenth audit's S1: round 9's M1 delivery again, its shots.json led by U+FEFF
cases.why: every reader of the written file drops the mark and reads the whole document, so the check must read what they read: the kit refuses a text its readers would read differently, the site cannot parse it

cases.name: the tenth audit's S1: 3000 levers past the cap, led by U+FEFF
cases.why: the mark made every check answer 'no levers' while the window read all 3000

cases.name: an ordinary delivery, its shots.json led by U+FEFF
cases.why: the mark alone: the same files without it are sent (the next case)

cases.name: control: the same ordinary delivery without the mark
cases.why: nothing in it is refused

cases.name: an ordinary delivery, its adapter.json led by U+FEFF
cases.why: the kit names the mark rather than reading the adapter as naming no game; the site cannot parse it

cases.name: a shots.json that is not JSON
cases.why: a check that cannot read the file must refuse it, not answer 'no levers'

cases.name: a shots.json whose top level is an array
cases.why: not an object: no reader finds a shot in it, and no check may answer 'nothing found' for it

cases.name: the tenth audit's M1: a ready write that is a number
cases.why: the ready block would run it as the text 5, and no lever list names a number

cases.name: a cheatUntil command's placeholder, undeclared
cases.why: a cheatUntil command is a lever like a cheat step's (the tenth audit: pinned on neither side before)

cases.name: the SECOND placeholder of a lever, undeclared
cases.why: every placeholder in a text is checked, not only the first

cases.name: control: both placeholders declared
cases.why: every placeholder in its levers is one of its own parameters

cases.name: a resistOff write holds a placeholder
cases.why: every ready write is sent as written, resistOff as much as mute

cases.name: the eleventh audit's S1: $schemaVersion nested 20,000 deep, with no levers
cases.why: the loader refuses the version, and its refusal used to render the value indented: 1.7 s and an 800,000,056-character error on every later load. The kit now refuses it before anything is written (past maxNesting, by name); the site refuses a version that is not the integer 1

cases.name: a shot the kit's loader refuses
cases.why: the eleventh audit, ruling 1: the delivery check is the loader, so a file it refuses any shot of is not written (it used to be written and its error reported)

cases.name: shots.json with a note nested exactly maxNesting deep
cases.why: at the nesting cap: read by both sides

cases.name: shots.json with a note nested one past maxNesting
cases.why: the kit's reader refuses nesting past the cap, by name, for every file it reads

cases.name: adapter.json with a note nested one past maxNesting
cases.why: the same reader reads adapter.json

cases.name: a lever of exactly maxLeverLength characters
cases.why: at the length cap: taken

cases.name: a lever one character over maxLeverLength
cases.why: the eleventh audit's M1: the window's cost grows with lever length, and the byte cap alone let a lever reach about 1.7 KB

cases.name: an overlay lever one character over maxLeverLength, its prefix counted
cases.why: the lever is 'hide-overlay ' and the type name: 257 characters

cases.name: the fourteenth audit, S1: a ready.muteGet whose lever 'get <muteGet>' is one character over maxLeverLength
cases.why: muteGet was capped by nothing but the 64 KB file (51 s in one pump at 2 KB, un-ticked); it is a lever now, the command the ready gate sends, prefix and all

cases.name: a ready.muteGet whose lever 'get <muteGet>' is exactly maxLeverLength
cases.why: at the cap: taken

cases.name: the eleventh audit's KB10: 301 date-shaped levers, 300 in shots.json and one in adapter.json
cases.why: over the cap, counted as every reader reads them: a reader that turned date-shaped strings into dates would count none of them and write 400 (the auditor's P9)

cases.name: a blank ready write beside a real one
cases.why: the eleventh audit's TS2: the ready gate reads a blank write as no command, while the kit's lever list asked a person to tick ' '

cases.name: a line break in ready.muteGet
cases.why: the eleventh audit's M3: the ready gate sends it as 'get A.b' and a second line (muteGet was no lever then; it is one since the fourteenth audit)

cases.name: a ready block that names no command the ready gate reads
cases.why: the ready gate fails every capture on a block that is present but names nothing it reads (the eleventh audit, ruling 1: the adapter's reader, too)

cases.name: the twelfth audit's S1: a cheatUntil with retryEvery 0 and an until that never holds
cases.why: the wait between tries yielded nothing, so the director ran the whole timeout inside one editor tick (2,001 ms at timeout 2)

cases.name: a cheatUntil with a negative retryEvery
cases.why: the same freeze as retryEvery 0

cases.name: a cheatUntil whose retryEvery is the literal NaN
cases.why: the kit's reader takes NaN as a number, and a NaN wait yielded nothing; the site's JSON.parse refuses the literal

cases.name: a cheatUntil whose retryEvery is 1e400
cases.why: not a finite number: the site reads Infinity, and a wait of Infinity never ends

cases.name: a waitFor with a timeout of 0
cases.why: every field read as seconds is held to minSeconds, not only retryEvery

cases.name: a cheatUntil with retryEvery at minSeconds
cases.why: at the floor: taken

cases.name: the twelfth audit's M1: a shot name one character over maxShotName
cases.why: the loader repeated the name in every step's address: a 263,799-character name over 9,300 steps cost 0.85 s on every load

cases.name: a shot name of exactly maxShotName characters
cases.why: at the cap: taken

cases.name: the thirteenth audit's S1: one command repeated maxSetup + 1 times in one shot's setup
cases.why: one lever, so the lever cap never saw it: 16,355 copies of one command froze the editor for 21.9 s in one tick

cases.name: one command repeated exactly maxSetup times
cases.why: at the cap: taken

cases.name: the thirteenth audit's S1: maxSteps + 1 steps in one shot
cases.why: a list of steps that never wait ran in one editor tick: 2,045 timeScale steps, 2,042 ms

cases.name: exactly maxSteps steps
cases.why: at the cap: taken

cases.name: the thirteenth audit's S2: a settle of maxConditionParts + 1 parts
cases.why: one evaluation of a 2,255-part condition took 1,984 ms of one editor tick on a 3,000-node canvas, and no yield can split an evaluation

cases.name: a settle of exactly maxConditionParts parts

cases.why: the cap counts the whole tree: counted per array, nesting would let eight levels of 64 through

cases.why: a wait of 1e300 s never ended, and the capture agent waited on the director for ever
